title: Fix Loading Metabolism Folder in Desktop
description: The metabolism folder at semio/assets/semio/metabolism/ has .semio/kit.db (SQLite) but the FolderKitStore expects .semio/kit.json. Need to convert/copy kit_metabolism.json to the folder's .semio/kit.json so the desktop can load it.
summary:
Fixed three issues preventing the desktop app from loading the metabolism folder:

1. **Missing kit.json**: Created `semio/assets/semio/metabolism/.semio/kit.json` (5MB) from `kit_metabolism.json` by stripping base64 blob data. Validated against KitSchema.

2. **GPU FATAL crash in container**: Added extra GPU disable flags (`disable-gpu`, `disable-gpu-compositing`, `disable-software-rasterizer`, `in-process-gpu`) to `main.ts` for containerized environments.

3. **Vite dependency re-optimization killing lazy imports**: Added `optimizeDeps.entries` in `vite.renderer.config.ts` to crawl sketchpad dependencies upfront, preventing mid-load page reloads.

Also fixed Tailwind CSS not loading by changing `desktop/globals.css` to import `../ui/globals.css` instead of using a restrictive `source()` directive.
